_doc: TEMPLATE routes file for qa-ui-parity-sweep — copy it next to your stack.config, fill in your pages, and pass it with `sweep.py init --routes FILE` (or inline the `routes` array under integrations.ui_parity.routes in stack.config.json). It is never used as a silent default. `path` is joined to the baseline and candidate environment urls (app.environments.<name>.url, names from integrations.ui_parity.baseline_env / candidate_env); give `baseline` / `candidate` instead of `path` when the two sides use different paths or record ids. The baseline is the design source of truth. `roots` is the content column dumped on each side (the app shell is out of scope); the candidate root is pinned to the baseline root's measured width so boxes compare — `main` is the neutral default. `modals` lists extra dialog triggers by exact accessible name — each MUST only open a dialog (never save/create/delete); triggers that declare aria-haspopup=dialog are discovered automatically. `area` groups routes for source lookup and the brain's source map.
_doc_probe: Per-toolkit knobs for the in-page probe (served to it as /config.json). Defaults are native HTML + ARIA only. guard_allow_hosts: regexes of hosts whose non-GET traffic the read-only guard lets through — your identity provider's hosts, so session refreshes are not refused. settle_selectors: in-flight transition classes to wait out. buttons_extra / dialogs_extra / dialog_close_extra: selectors your UI toolkit uses for button-like controls, open dialogs and a dialog's close control beyond the native/ARIA ones. utility_class_prefixes: regexes of utility or state class prefixes to drop from the class chain used for source lookup (spacing, display, router state). icon_class_patterns: regexes that name an icon from an <svg> class (an icon library's prefix).
_doc_source: Where `sweep.py locate` looks for the file that renders an element. candidate_paths: git pathspecs inside app.repo_dir ([] = the whole tree). baseline_repo_dir: the design reference's repo when it has one (relative to the framework checkout or absolute); baseline_paths likewise. extensions: files that can render an element ([] = any non-test file); component_extensions get +1 when ranking (markup lives there); style_extensions are the files a one-file style fix may touch; logic_dirs get -1 (logic, rarely markup or style).
_doc_console_noise: Console messages that are known noise IN THIS STACK, merged with the framework's neutral list (assets/console-noise.json): third-party widgets, your analytics script, your identity provider's dev-instance banner, your toolkit's dev-mode notices. `pattern` is a case-insensitive regex tested against the message text. Add a pattern only when you can say what emits it — an app error hidden here is an outage nobody sees.
